# Server action: expone reglas de x_commercial_time + configs de pos.config # bypassando la ir.rule de pos.config para que los cajeros restringidos # vean horarios y filtro de ciudad de toda su compañía.
allowed_company_ids = env.context.get("allowed_company_ids") or env.companies.ids
# 1) Reglas de horario comercial con sudo (bypass ir.rule en el m2m) rules = env["x_commercial_time"].sudo().search_read( domain=[], fields=[ "x_studio_pdv", "x_studio_opening", "x_studio_closing", "x_studio_tolerance_min", "x_studio_day_type", "x_studio_shift_type", ], limit=500, )
# 2) PDVs de las compañías permitidas con sudo (bypass ir.rule pos.config) configs = env["pos.config"].sudo().search_read( domain=[("company_id", "in", allowed_company_ids)], fields=["id", "name", "city_id", "company_id"], limit=500, ) allowed_config_ids = set([c["id"] for c in configs])
# 3) Filtra reglas a PDVs visibles + serializa datetimes y selections filtered_rules = [] for r in rules: pdv_ids = r.get("x_studio_pdv") or [] visible_pdvs = [pid for pid in pdv_ids if pid in allowed_config_ids] if not visible_pdvs: continue r["x_studio_pdv"] = visible_pdvs
for k in ("x_studio_opening", "x_studio_closing"): v = r.get(k) if isinstance(v, datetime.datetime): r[k] = v.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") elif isinstance(v, datetime.date): r[k] = v.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
for k in ("x_studio_day_type", "x_studio_shift_type"): v = r.get(k) if isinstance(v, list) or isinstance(v, tuple): r[k] = v[0] if v else False
filtered_rules.append(r)
action = { "type": "ir.actions.act_window_close", "infos": { "rules": filtered_rules, "configs": configs, }, }

field.p: Por defecto, contiene una lista y una vista de formulario y posiblemente otros tipos de vista dependiendo de las opciones que hayas elegido para tu modelo.
